title: Best Robotic Arm (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were chosen by looking for products mentioned in the provided sources and giving priority to those cited by more than one source (Roborock).
assumptions: No price information was added except where a source gave a figure; all other details come directly from the excerpts.

verdict.pick: Roborock Saros Z70 Robot Vacuum with Mechanical Arm
verdict.line: Buy it if you want a robot that not only vacuums but also picks up small items around the house. It’s the only vacuum in this guide with a built‑in arm that can move socks, shoes and other objects to a storage box. The catch is its high price.
